description: Capability for the main window. Only what the WebView itself calls: notification, dialog, fs and updater are driven from Rust (alerts/notify.rs; commands/system.rs and library.rs; commands/system.rs again for fs, which exists only because a save dialog on Android answers with a content:// URI that std::fs cannot open; commands/update.rs), and Tauri 2 enforces this ACL at the IPC boundary alone, so granting them here gave the page a door it never needed and the Rust side nothing. The opener permissions are listed one by one rather than taking opener:default, which also carries allow-reveal-item-in-dir — a command nothing in the WebView calls and, unlike open_url and open_path, one the plugin runs with no scope check at all, so any script in the page could spawn file-manager windows on paths of its choosing. allow-close is load-bearing: the titlebar's X calls close() so that Rust's CloseRequested handler decides between hiding and quitting, which is the only place that knows whether a tray exists.
